title: Macroscopic Multistability and Bifurcations in Theta-Neuron Networks with Distributed Delays
summary: We study an all-to-all coupled network of identical theta neurons with synaptic interaction mediated by a distributed time delay. Using the Watanabe-Strogatz reduction and passing to the thermodynamic limit under the assumption of uniformly distributed constants of motion, we derive a single delay differential equation for the complex order parameter. The delay is modeled by a family of delay kernels with prescribed mean delay, allowing discrete and distributed delays to be treated in a unified framework.
